Per your 2026-09-03 routing:

| Email | To |
|---|---|
| Lead replied / wants call | **Brandon only**. Include the lead's actual reply text (not a summary) and link or attach the pitch folder. |
| Lead signed | **You (`nseluga@bcn-services.com`) + Brandon**. Subject along the lines of "signed, onboard". |

Notes:
- Never send to your personal or school address. It's only allowed as the test target during a manual run.
- `NOTIFY_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS` can include you while the pipeline is in test. Narrow it to Brandon once the flow is confirmed. Otherwise the allowlist will drop or allow the wrong recipients.
- Opt-outs and Brandon's call notes don't get an email. They go to the database only.
- Mechanism and env vars are in bcns-internal `docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md`.
